source_type: already-local Dataset Viewer JPEG previews, not full-resolution original dataset
source_pool_reuse: sources repeat across samples; distinct ordered samples do not imply independent unique photos
selection: random.Random(seed + N*100000 + sample_index).sample(range(8), N); same assignments in both conditions

padded_control.fit: aspect ratio preserved, complete field of view retained, centered gray RGB128 padding, no crop
padded_control.caution: padding is a controlled intervention; this does not establish model quality or a native solution for arbitrary image shapes

scope: official processor plus tokenizer, NumPy, CPU; no weights or model forward or training
